names.note: The name as name page 14953 gives it, «Фамарь (Марджанова), прп., исп.», with the two grades taken off; the day's line prints the surname without the parentheses, «Фамари Марджановой», in the genitive. Measured with the gate's own fold before it was written: 'марджанова фамарь' has no other holder, and a Cyrillic grep for «Марджанов» over every saint.json returned nothing. Her name in the world, Tamara, is in the article teaser the name page prints and was NOT stored as a form: the corpus keeps three Tamaras and a baptismal name is not the calendar's form for her.

death.note: The year the line closes with, «(1936)». The heading of the first article her name page links repeats it and adds a year of birth — «Святая схиигумения Фамарь (Марджанова; 1868–1936)» — but the article itself was not read and the birth year is left out of `dates` rather than taken off a headline.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 июня ст. ст. — «Прп. Фамари Марджановой, исп (1936) (Груз.).»

attestations.note: The day's eleventh entry. A line and a name page and two unread articles. The calendar grades her прп. and исп. and not новомуч., so `new-martyr` is not in `types`, which is the `raphael-sheichenko` reading of 06-06. «(Груз.)» is this calendar's own mark for a saint of the Georgian Church and is quoted in the row above as printed. `abbess` is in `types` on the strength of the article heading's «схиигумения», which is page content; **no `office` was written**, because `Abbess` is one of the strings BRIEF-ADDENDUM §4 names as absent from the locale packs, and the four translations it would cost are not a reader's to invent. `ls -d saints/thamar* saints/tamara*` returned three Tamaras, all other women, and `fk.mjs` no holder for either form. azbyka.ru was not read, and the two Pravoslavie.Ru articles were not read.
